plan.why: Its Express server is small, so llocal rewrites it in Go on llocal's kit. A Go server starts in a moment and needs little memory, so the app is quick and can sleep when nobody is using it.
found: An app with its own Express server and a React front end.
3 server routes, like GET /api/repairs, POST /api/repairs/{id}/notes and POST /api/report.
A PostgreSQL database, with 2 tables: repairs and repair_notes.

left.text: Its data is in PostgreSQL (2 tables) and moves into one SQLite file beside the app.
Its Express server (3 routes in 2 files, 1 KB) is rewritten in Go on llocal's kit.
It has no llocal.json yet: the short file that tells llocal how to build and start it.

changes.text: The PostgreSQL data moves into one SQLite file on llocal, copied over once.
changes.detail: SQLite sits right next to the app, so it is fast, it is backed up with the app, and only people who can open the app reach the data.

changes.text: The Express server is rewritten in Go on llocal's kit, answering at the same addresses.
changes.detail: A Go server starts in a moment and needs little memory, so the app is quick and can sleep when nobody is using it.

needs.text: So llocal can copy your data once: the full address of your PostgreSQL database, like the one in DATABASE_URL, with a user that can read all of it. It is used for the copy, then thrown away.
